title.narrative: Strengthening Local Civil Society Leadership for Area-Based Recovery, Accountability, and Resilient Development in Yemen

description.narrative: Following years of protracted conflict, institutional fragmentation, economic decline, and climate-related shocks, local civil society actors in Yemen have emerged as critical pillars of community resilience, mediation, social cohesion and locally driven recovery. Yet many Yemeni organizations continue to engage with the international system primarily through short-term implementation arrangements that limit their strategic positioning and institutional growth. This Initiation Plan responds directly to these dynamics by strengthening the institutional, operational and strategic capacities of Yemeni civil society organizations to contribute to locally led, accountable, conflict-sensitive and environmentally sustainable area-based recovery and resilience programming.The intervention will deliver four intensive regional capacity-building programmes across Aden, Mukalla, Taiz, and Marib, structured around Area-Based Development, Accountability to Affected Populations, Environmental and Social Standards, Conflict Sensitivity, and Operational Readiness. It will be complemented by structured institutional accompaniment (mentorship, coaching, operational tool adaptation, and peer learning) and by technical support for community-based disaster risk reduction and early warning aligned with national and sub-national DRR frameworks. The initiative targets 100–120 local NGO representatives, with a strong emphasis on women-led and youth-led organizations, and is implemented within a funding envelope of USD 95,000 over 6 months

condition.narrative: Social and environmental sustainability will be enhanced through application of the UNDP Social and Environmental Standards (http://www.undp.org/ses) and related Accountability Mechanism (http://www.undp.org/secu-srm).

The Implementing Partner shall ensure that all of its obligations set forth under the section entitled “Legal Context and/or Risk Management Standard Clauses” are passed on to each responsible party, subcontractor and sub-recipient and that all the clauses under this section entitled “Risk Management” are included, mutatis mutandis, in all sub-contracts or sub-agreements entered into further to the Project Document
